papers.title_en: SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving
papers.authors: Haoran Qiu, Rohan Mahapatra, Rodrigo Fonseca, Mark Russinovich
papers.evidence: 在智能体工作流模型切换间预热前缀KV缓存
papers.tldr: 按步路由的 agent 系统每次切换模型都会丢失前缀缓存，切换调用耗时增至 1.5-3.2 倍，前缀命中率从 80-89% 降至 44-65%。SHADOWPREFILL 利用正常流量留下的闲置容量，提前在未被路由选中的模型上预填该会话上下文，并配合在途请求的每轮 SLO 余量、影子 KV 换出到主机内存，以及影子不完整时的冷切换回退。在五个 agent 基准、24 个模型对上的测试中，切换调用延迟降低 8.5-21.4%，路由 token 成本降低 22.5-46.1%，正常流量 SLO 不受影响，每请求能耗仅增 0.4%。
papers.abstract_en: Per-step model routers send each LLM call of an agent to the cost-optimal model dynamically within each session. However, every model switch discards prefix-cache reuse: KV caches are per model, so the new model must prefill the relevant context before it emits a token. Across representative agentic workloads, including a production coding-agent trace with a mean context of 63K tokens, the prefix hit rate falls from 80-89% on same model calls to 44-65% after a switch, and a switch call takes 1.5-3.2x as long. We present SHADOWPREFILL, which prefills the session's context on the model the router has not chosen, in capacity that instances serving normal traffic leave idle, so the next switch finds its prefix cached. SHADOWPREFILL harvests the per-iteration SLO slack of requests in flight, protects routed calls, spills shadow KV to host memory, and falls back to a cold switch whenever the shadow is incomplete. With LLMRouter routing 24 model pairs over five agentic benchmark suites, SHADOWPREFILL cuts switch-call latency by 8.5-21.4%, LLM-call latency by 3.7-17.7%, and routed token cost by 22.5-46.1%, while normal traffic keeps its SLO and energy per request rises by 0.4%.

papers.title_en: Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving
papers.evidence: 前缀缓存智能体服务与缓存命中调度
papers.tldr: LLM智能体每轮增长上下文，前缀缓存命中仅增量预填充、未命中重算长上下文，使服务呈现亚稳态。作者用受控突发负载在vLLM/SGLang及SWE-bench轨迹上复现持久退化，并分析工作集与KV池的平衡条件。短时额外到达可令命中率降至约10%、吞吐减半且积压持续70分钟；限流仅救回1/7，暂停会话可全部恢复，按KV预算控制则全部预防。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents drive inference engines with closed-loop sessions whose context grows every turn, and serving them economically depends on prefix caching: a hit costs an incremental prefill of about a thousand tokens, a miss recomputes a 10--40K-token context. We show that this makes prefix-cached agent serving metastable. With an identical base workload, a few minutes of extra arrivals leaves a vLLM server in a degraded regime--a ~10% hit ratio, about half the throughput, and a backlog that grows for the remaining 70 minutes--while its no-burst twin stays healthy (9 of 12 pairs; none in the reverse direction). The regime appears at loads the cache-warm server sustains, is absent without prefix caching, and also appears with Qwen3-32B on SWE-bench agent trace shapes and on SGLang, which tolerates larger triggers. Slower service keeps more sessions in the system, their working set outgrows the KV pool, and every turn becomes a recomputation; a first-order workload-balance condition, calibrated independently, brackets when the regime can drain. Getting out is the harder problem: throttling new admissions recovered 1 of 7 matched collapsed runs, while suspending admitted sessions against a capacity-based limit recovered all of them within minutes. A CPU offload tier delays the collapse but does not prevent it. A budgeter that bounds the resident KV demand of active sessions to the pool, with thresholds that need no per-workload tuning, prevented the failure in every run we tested.

papers.title_en: Ostinato: Fast CPU-GPU MoE Inference for Local Agents via Resident Experts in Every Forward Pass
papers.evidence: 为本地智能体推理保持热点专家常驻的专家缓存调度
papers.tldr: 本地智能体在少量消费级GPU上运行大MoE模型时，现有CPU-GPU引擎难以同时兼顾快速prefill与decode，工具输出后常需等待数秒。Ostinato利用短prefill中84%的专家路由集中于可驻留GPU的稳定专家集，让GPU在每次前向计算这些常驻专家，并分别处理长prefill冷专家上传与decode固定CUDA图。在四张RTX 4090D上运行DeepSeek-V4-Flash的编程与客服会话，它两阶段均最快，工具输出后中位等待降22-55%，会话完成快1.4-2.5倍。该工作为本地智能体提供兼顾两阶段的CPU-GPU MoE推理方案。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly run on workstations with a few consumer GPUs, where large mixture-of-experts (MoE) models keep part of their experts in host memory. With existing CPU-GPU engines, these agents get fast prefill or fast decode, not both: llama.cpp's expert cache skips forward passes of more than 32 tokens to keep the experts of decode cached, so an agent waits 2.1-2.8 s after each tool output, whereas its default layer placement shortens this wait but is 1.5-1.6$\times$ slower in decode. Our key insight is that a short prefill touches too many distinct experts to upload, yet sends 84% of its expert activations (routes) to a stable set of experts that fits in GPU memory. We present Ostinato, a CPU-GPU MoE inference engine that computes these experts on the GPUs in every forward pass without changing what the model computes. Short prefills split their routes, leaving fewer than one of a token's six routed experts per layer to the CPU; long prefills upload each distinct cold expert once; and each decode step runs as one fixed-shape CUDA graph per GPU. On real coding and customer-service agent sessions with DeepSeek-V4-Flash on four RTX 4090D GPUs, Ostinato is the fastest engine in both phases and finishes every session sooner than all six baselines. Against llama.cpp and KTransformers, it cuts the median wait after a tool output by 22-55% and finishes sessions 1.4-2.5$\times$ sooner.

papers.title_en: Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.authors: Weizhong Huang, Huaijia Kou, Tianyu Xie, Xiawu Zheng, Liujuan Cao
papers.evidence: 由规划器语义引导的免训练KV缓存压缩，属于智能体流程内的缓存策略
papers.tldr: 面向智能体自回归视频生成，视觉历史增长会显著膨胀 KV cache，推高显存与注意力开销。SemanticKV 无需训练，利用规划器提取的语义约束，通过文本交叉注意力定位相关视频位置，分组聚合自注意力并按组最大化打分，再用一次 top-k 保留关键条目。在 Causal Forcing、压缩率 0.7 下，VBench 总分 84.10，超过最强压缩基线 84.05 与 Full KV 的 83.99，并实现 1.22 倍加速、KV 显存由 6.04 GB 降至 1.81 GB。该工作首次将规划器语义约束用于智能体视频生成的 KV 压缩，在近无损质量下显著降低显存与计算成本。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

papers.title_en: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
papers.authors: Hao Kang, Weili Xu, Ziyang Li, Zheng Du, Hanchen Li, Tian Xia, Song Bian, Tushar Krishna, Huizi Mao, Ion Stoica, Song Han
papers.evidence: 面向智能体负载的KV缓存管理与驱逐
papers.tldr: 智能体负载已成为 LLM 推理的重要需求，但现有 PD 分离服务对运行时算力分配和 KV 缓存管理缺乏灵活适配，易造成预填充/解码节点负载失衡与缓存误驱逐。Evolving Infra 将算力分配与 KV 缓存管理解耦，使节点可在预填充与解码间高效切换，并用在线规划器匹配 PD 切分、以智能体感知的分布式 KV 管理器指导驱逐与迁移。在编码、数学和计算机使用任务上，基于 GLM-5.2、Kimi K2.6 与最多 256 块 GB300 GPU，相比 Dynamo 将平均端到端时延和 P95 TTFT 分别最多降低 4.1 倍和 14 倍。该工作为大规模智能体推理提供了运行时自适应服务框架。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework.

papers.title_en: Multi-Objective Scheduling of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Workflows in Cloud Computing
papers.evidence: 云环境中LLM多智能体工作流的调度
papers.tldr: LLM多智能体工作流在云上调度时，需同时权衡时延、费用与资源利用率，但现有框架多关注输出质量，忽视推理时延、异构算力与云计费开销。论文将其建模为多目标优化问题，提出MO-SAIC框架，包含NSGA-II、W-GA、MO-HEFT与随机基线四类调度器。实验从工作流调度、多目标优化和系统视角评估整体性能与Pareto前沿质量，并用Wilcoxon检验验证显著性。该工作为云上LLM多智能体工作流的多目标调度提供了系统化建模与基准。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly composed into multi-agent workflows to accomplish complex and multi-step tasks. As the open-weight models continue to close the performance gap with the proprietary ones, model parameters are becoming a less significant source of competitive advantage in the artificial intelligence market. Yet how these models are efficiently scheduled onto distributed infrastructure such as the cloud, with respect to overall latency, monetary cost and resource utilization, remains largely unaddressed in the literature despite being an increasingly critical problem. Existing agentic workflow frameworks mostly focus on output quality and task success rates over popular benchmarks, rarely accounting for execution dynamics of LLM-based agents such as inference latency, computation power of heterogeneous resources, cloud-specific billing period and resource provisioning overheads. Therefore, this paper formulates multi-agent scheduling in cloud computing as a multi-objective optimization problem that jointly minimizes makespan and cost while maximizing resource utilization. Building on this formulation, we propose MO-SAIC (Multi-Objective Scheduling of Multi-Agent Workflows in Cloud Computing), a scheduling framework comprising four multi-objective schedulers with Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II), Weighted-Sum Genetic Algorithm (W-GA), a multi-objective adaptation of Heterogeneous Earliest Finish Time (MO-HEFT) and a random baseline (RAND). We evaluate the schedulers from the workflow scheduling, multi-objective optimization and system perspectives to measure their overall performance, quality of their Pareto-optimal fronts and impacts of workflow topology, cloud resource composition and scalability parameters. We report the experimental results with their statistical significance via the Wilcoxon test.
